verdict.rationale: Gemini's first-party docs show privacy controls: users can review and delete Gemini Apps activity and turn off Keep Activity at any time [gemini-docs-31]. Audio, Live video and screenshare use for model improvement is presented as something the user chooses to allow [gemini-docs-37], and under some conditions chats and uploaded files are not reviewed or used for training [gemini-docs-38]. These controls cover activity history and training-data use, not an explicit opt-out of telemetry or usage analytics. missing for 10: an explicit telemetry/usage-analytics opt-out, docs on what diagnostic data is still collected after opting out, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the controls work.
